Malee vs competitors: price per ml

Malee juice and coconut-water SKUs found on three retailers' public pages today, each priced per ml against competitor SKUs with the same category, juice %, size and pack. Includes this week's promotions.
Captured Sun 8 Nov 2026, 09:47–10:12 ICT
Lotus's online · 7-Eleven All Online and store leaflets · Big C leaflets
Public pages only, no logins

Headline

Malee costs about the same per ml as competitors (index 101.5, median of 36 like-for-like comparisons today), but it is missing from this week's promotions. Lotus's weekly list has 20 Tipco and Chabaa juices and no Malee.

How to read the index: the index is Malee's price per ml divided by the median price per ml of matched competitor SKUs at the same retailer, × 100. 100 means the same price. 110 means Malee is 10% dearer. 90 means Malee is 10% cheaper. It uses today's selling price. Multi-buy deals (buy 2 for ฿X) are shown separately and are not in the index.

Promotion calendar

November 2026 for five flagship SKUs. Only an offer with both a start and an end printed on the source is drawn on the grid.

Selected 5 flagship SKUs — not sales-ranked. Orange 1 L is มาลี น้ำส้มเขียวหวานผสมน้ำผักผลไม้ 1 ลิตร. Apple 1 L is มาลีน้ำแอปเปิ้ล100% 1000มล. Coco 1 L is มาลีโคโค่ น้ำมะพร้าว 100% 1ล. Orange 200 ml ×3 is มาลี น้ำส้มเขียวหวาน 200 มล แพ็ค 3. Coco 350 ml is มาลี น้ำมะพร้าว 100% 350 มล. These are the standard packs this 8 Nov capture actually contains, each with same-flavour peers. Orange uses เขียวหวาน, the ฿85 line, not the dearer pulp 1 L. This file has no sales data, so the five are not a sales rank.

Seen Sun 8 Nov 2026, 09:47–10:12 ICT. Not live prices. Four offers have both dates: the Big C leaflet 5 Nov–2 Dec (Malee Signature 1 L, Unif 1 L, Chabaa apple 1 L) and the 7-Eleven store leaflet 5–11 Nov (Shinsun 250 ml). Lotus's prints no promo end date. All Online listing end equals 8 Nov and rolls daily, so it is unconfirmed. Pre-orders that closed 15 Oct are history on the October view only.

Method

  • Price per ml = pack price ÷ (units × ml per unit). The page shows ฿ per 100 ml, and the exact ฿/ml to 4 decimals. The CSV keeps full precision.
  • Match: same retailer and channel, category, juice-% band (98–100%, 40–59%, 20–39%, under 20%), unit-size band (1 L, 300–450 ml, 150–299 ml) and single or multipack. A High match also has the same flavour family; Medium means the same segment but a different flavour. Peers with the same flavour are used whenever any exist.
  • Index = Malee ฿/ml ÷ median peer ฿/ml × 100, using today's selling price. The shelf-price index uses the pre-cut price. Retailer and overall figures are unweighted medians with n. There are no sales weights.
  • Excluded from the index: multi-buy and basket deals (shown separately), pre-order listings, rows without a stated volume in ml (ounces or grams are never converted), unknown juice %, non-drinks, chilled Tipco Squeeze, and listings with an unclear unit. Juice % comes from the product name, otherwise from the ingredient list on the product page; the retailer's own category is not used.
  • Self-check: the build recomputes every index from the raw prices (36 comparisons, 167 peer links) and fails if any differ.

Download all 317 rows (CSV)

Coverage and gaps

  • Lotus's: online store, default online branch, logged out. Prices can differ by branch and in store. Product pages show no promo dates. The weekly promotion list loaded 1,590 items and was scrolled until it stopped growing.
  • 7-Eleven: the store leaflets (sale, trade, combo and redeem pages, 8 Nov) contain no Malee SKU. The All Online listings are multipacks (units read from the retailer's product images) and are kept separate from store promotions. All Online end dates equal to today roll daily. The Malee coconut listings there are pre-orders whose 1–15 Oct window has passed, so they are excluded.
  • Big C: the online shop (bigc.co.th) returned 403, and page 3 of the corporate promotions page also returned 403. Neither was retried or bypassed. The leaflets were read by eye: Hyper bro11 (33 pages), Market, Foodplace and the multi-brand leaflet. The tourist and Moment of Joy catalogs on page 2 were not scanned.
  • Not found today: no Nestlé juice was looked for or added. Competitors searched: Tipco, UFC, Doi Kham, Chabaa, Unif, Cocomax and IF (via coconut-water search). Some UFC and Chabaa rows were dropped for unclear juice % or units.
  • Artwork: product photos are the retailer's own product-page image (og:image) or a crop of the leaflet page, embedded as small WebP files for internal review only. Hover over an image for its source.
